_comment: Copy this to statusline.config.json in the same folder as statusline.js. Your overrides deep-merge over the built-in defaults, so you only need the keys you actually change. Easiest way to edit: `node statusline.js --config`. 256-color codes: https://www.ditig.com/256-colors-cheat-sheet
_resetStyle: auto (the locale's clock: 14:40 where clocks run to 24, else 2:40p) | clock | clock24 (24-hour) | relative
_ambiguousWidth: How wide the box-drawing glyphs are in your terminal: auto (2 cells under a ja, zh or ko locale) | narrow | wide. CCRIG_AMBIGUOUS overrides it for one terminal.
_guardian: The next block powers the guardian, which is ON by default (autopilot:notify). It checkpoints your work + sends a desktop ping at limits, but never launches anything unattended. Set autopilot:off for a bar-only, side-effect-free install. --auto (or autopilot:resume) adds hands-free relaunch; keepWorking + resume need the hooks wired by --install-guardian.
_autopilotBypassPermissions: Opt-in: let the unattended auto-resume relaunch bypass permission prompts (it is headless and cannot answer one). Off by default; only affects the guardian's own relaunch.
_sessionBoard: The cross-session board (`--board`). Turn it on and each session publishes its state to a shared folder in your home directory, so --board can show a lamp per session: red waiting on you, yellow working, green just finished, grey gone quiet. `ccrig board on` sets this and wires the lamp hooks (`ccrig board off` takes them out). boardDecayMinutes is how long green lasts; boardNotify is the desktop ping from `--board --watch`.
_autoUpdate: Opt-in. When the daily check finds a newer release, install it in the background: an npm install runs npm install -g ccrig@<version> into its own prefix (only if you can write there, never sudo); a standalone copy takes the validated, backed-up --update swap; a git clone is left alone.
_updatePubkey: Empty = TLS-only updates (default). Paste an Ed25519 PUBLIC key (PEM) to REQUIRE a signed statusline.js.sig on every --update. See the statusline.js header for the openssl commands.
_profileLabels: Map a config-dir name to a label, e.g. {".claude":"work",".claude-personal":"personal"}. Default {} derives labels from the dir name.
_style: refined (default): a rule line above the bar, text labels, thin meters, color only where it means something | classic: the pre-1.9 look (emoji icons, block bars). CCRIG_STYLE=classic overrides it for one terminal.
_rule: refined only: the full-width line above the bar that sets it apart from the transcript; it turns amber, then red, near a limit. false hides it and puts a ▾ at the start of the first line instead.
_glyphs: unicode (default) | ascii: ASCII stand-ins (= - | ! @ *) for a terminal font without box-drawing glyphs, such as the legacy Windows console. CCRIG_GLYPHS sets it for one terminal.
_collapsed: Fold the CCRig section to one summary line. Toggle it with `ccrig collapse | expand | toggle` or /ccrig:toggle inside a session.
_color: Omit a key to keep the active style's palette. These are the refined defaults; classic uses its own.
